title: ABH SOFT GLAM Palette Cut Crease Tutorial
description:
♡ SUBSCRIBE for more weekly video's → https://www.youtube.com/c/anknook?sub=

Hey Cuties! ♡
Welcome back to my YouTube channel.
I received the new ABH Soft Glam Palette last week so I could not wait to film a video with it. When I was in LA in August I already got the honor to play with this palette. You can find the video I filmed with them on the ABH Instagram page. I was excited to receive the palette because I already forgot what palette looked like haha! Hope you like how the look turned out. If you wanna see more video's with the palette, let me know!
Much love for all of you  ♡♡♡
